## Summary

Verifies the CSDB objects in a folder (DMC and PMC by default) in one run, and returns the verification status of each object and a count summary. Read the results in parts with `offset` and `limit`, and write the details to JSON with `reportPath`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Verify every CSDB object (data modules by default; optionally publication modules etc.) found in the given folders, and return one VerificationStatus per object plus totals (valid / XSD errors / BREX violations / unresolved references / unreadable). Use offset/limit to page. Pass reportPath to also write the full JSON report to a file.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | Folders to verify (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). Referenced objects are also searched here. When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `include` | `array<string>` |  |  | Object kinds to verify (default: dm and pm). |
| `skip` | `array<string>` |  |  | Steps to skip. Skipped steps are reported with state "not-run". |
| `offset` | `number` |  | default `0` | Index of the first object (default 0). |
| `limit` | `number` |  | default `100` | Objects per call (default 100, max 1000). |
| `reportPath` | `string` |  |  | If given, the full report (all details) is written to this JSON file; the response keeps only the statuses. |
